batting.name: AG Paunikar
batting.dismissal: st MS Bisla b Iqbal Abdulla

batting.name: AS Raut
batting.dismissal: run out (Shakib Al Hasan, MS Bisla)

batting.name: AL Menaria
batting.dismissal: c R Bhatia b L Balaji

batting.name: LRPL Taylor
batting.dismissal: st MS Bisla b YK Pathan

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c LRPL Taylor b SW Tait

batting.name: MS Bisla
batting.dismissal: c AS Raut b SK Warne

balls.text: Brett Lee goes full and fast, too much for Trivedi, bat comes down late, and Brett uproots middle stump, punches the air, Kolkata have run away with this one
hangs on the back foot, and guides this shortish one past point
for the second time today, the hat trick ball does not earn the bowler a wicket, defended off the front foot

Shakib Al Hasan on a hat trick, tossed up this time, draws him forward, pushing outside the line for the turn, there isn't any, goes straight on and strikes timber, Shakib is pumped up, intelligent bowling from the Bangladesh captain
that man at silly mid off was playing on his mind, he was pegged on the back foot, Shakib did him in with the arm ball, did not turn, skidded straight on, kept low, and clatter! go the stumps
pushed away from the crease towards covers
a touch short outside off, allows him to cut it away to sweeper cover
turns away from middle stump, calmly defended down the track

Menaria succeeds in what he was trying to do, waits for the short one close to off, and connects with the upper cut, but the ball flies at a nice height to third man who runs some steps to his right and happily takes it, nothing going right for Rajasthan, Balaji all over them
bouncer going across the left-hander, digs it in hard, he looks to upper-cut it but is beaten by the extra bounce
slower one cutting in from short of a length outside off, Warne stays beside the line and guides it past point
this is super stuff from Balaji, has Warne uncertainly pushing at one that angles in from a fuller length, and stays low
bowled fuller around middle, he shuffles and plays it to mid on

Rahane comes down the track, and gets in to a very awkward position, Balaji angles it in on a length, it even cuts back in, and Rahane ends up having a weak stab outside the line, and the ball uproots middle stump, it's been a long struggle for Rajasthan, this innings
eep, could have been another one, comes down the track, is not close to the pitch of the ball, and ungainly chips it in the air but it falls well short of long on
Rahane implores Menaria for two, but he is satisfied with one as sweeper cover gets to the ball that is cut to him, could have been two there
a touch fuller, he makes room and tries to play a strange-looking dab through point, gets the single
shortish and turning in, but he cannot get the punch past YK
rocks back and cuts hard from just outside off stump, sweeper cover fields
goes back and pushes with the turn to long on
tucked away off the pads to fine leg
works this one turning in from outside off in front of square leg
eases a very full ball to sweeper cover along the ground
worked away off the pads but straight to short fine leg, this one keeps low as well
works a tossed up ball against the turn from outside off through midwicket
worked away through square leg for a single
the ball is keeping very low off the spinners, this one is worked away from middle to the right of YK who dives and stops the single

more trouble for Rajasthan, this time it is Taylor, overbalances and walks outside the crease looking to work a flatter one turning down leg side, misses the ball and Bisla pulls off a smart stumping, whipping off the bails with one hand to catch Ross just short
comes slowly off the pitch outside off and he hits it past the bowler to long off
goes reaching out for a short and wide one outside off, but misses as he looks to dab it past slip
fuller around off stump, he comes forward and pushes for a single in front of covers
short and turning away from Menaria, who rocks back and cuts it to sweeper cover
turned off the pads behind square leg for a single
turns slowly down the leg side from middle stump
shuffles across and works this one past the non-striker
turning in from outside off stump, worked away  in front of square leg
comes forward and guides a fuller one behind point
stays low outside off stump, he waits for it and cuts it past the man at point, cut off by sweeper cover
looks to work this one on leg stump away but cannot time it
sharp turn for Shakib  now, goes across the batsman from middle, he almost pushes it straight to the bowler, Shakib with a neat stop to his left
Menaria takes off over deep midwicket, fuller and he bends the knee and smokes it in to the crowd with a big backlift, his style resembles the man who captains Pune Warriors
pushed away close to the non-striker off the front foot
that looked close, strikes him low in front of middle as he goes back and misses the waft, umpire Dar thinks it pitched outside leg, Iqbal was already celebrating, Dar is spot-on
tossed up but on leg stump, flicks it wide of midwicket
stays on the back foot and works it away in front of midwicket
keeps low again, and turns down the leg side
almost another one, this one does not get up much, whipped away off the pads, inches away from a diving square leg

yet another run-out, flicked away to midwicket, striker takes off, Menaria is unmoved, Raut is almost mid-pitch before he turns back, throw comes in right on top of the stumps, and he had no chance of making it back
this one angles away from a length outside off stump, steered away to short third man
pushed away in front of covers from a length on off stump
cutting in from outside leg, he hangs back and works it away to deep midwicket
dabbed it wide of Lee at short third man who runs to his left and cuts it off
moves away from wide outside off, he cannot get it away, steering it to backward point
a touch short and turning away, cut away to sweeper cover

super stuff from Iqbal, brilliant presence of mind, it was pushed in the air way to his right, he charged after the ball to stop the single, picked it up with a dive, and then looked to throw it to the keeper, but stopped for an instant, saw the non-striker had backed up too far, and hit his stumps with a direct throw
more turn for Iqbal, and some bounce on this one too, takes off from a length on middle, batsman is surprised and jabs it away
shuffles across and whips a shortish one to deep midwicket
sharp turn from middle stump, he closes the face early and gets a leading edge towards point
tossed up but he goes back, it hurries on but he manages to stab it back to the bowler
has another huge swipe as he rushes outside his crease, but gets only a single to mid on
charges out again, this time Balaji goes fuller and angles it in to him, but he swipes and gets an inside edge that runs for four to the left of fine leg
charges down the track, Balaji fires in the short one in to him, and he gets the pull over square leg
another beauty from Balaji, gets it to pitch around off and move away, he feels for it and misses
shuffles across, and overbalances but manages to flick it away to fine leg
angled wide across the left-hander, slapped away to covers off the front foot
some flight from Iqbal, gets him forward and he pushes away towards point
flatter one turning away outside off, almost pushed straight to cover, bounces short of him
after Balaji, it is Iqbal, the classic left-arm spinner's trick, draws the batsman out with some flight, beats the batsman, gets it to turn past him, and the keeper does the rest
fired in flat and full, pushed back to the bowler
pushed away off the front foot
good diving effort on the wide long off boundary, it is Bhatia, saves the boundary after Paunikar drove a flat one outside off hard
angles in on a length around off stump, pushed away towards covers
short and wide, deserved to be put away, but Fazal went for a weak dab and almost hit in straight to third man, goes to him on the bounce

he stopped doing that after Pakistan 2004, ripper from Balaji, pitches on a length on middle and zips away to hit off stump, the perfect delivery, no one can do anything about that, not even Shan Watson who is the form of his life, he has to go
clattered! short and slow, sitting up for Watson, "hit me", says Raghav, and Watson obliges, pulling it neatly over midwicket
slower one way outside off, Watson goes down on the knee for the big drive, but misses
angled in from a length on middle stump, Watson pushes it away on the leg side
dismisses, Lee has been on the shorter side, but he also goes wide outside off now, and Paunikar cracks it in the air to the point boundary
good ball, moves away from a length outside off, he goes for a cut from close to the body, but misses
cannot get it away, gets hold of a short one around off but pulls it straight to the man at midwicket on the edge of the circle
140.7 kph bouncer that Paunikar ducks underneath right away, Lee oversteps, free hit coming up
slower bouncer, does not get up much, and Watson pulls it awkwardly from way outside off to deep square leg
pacy delivery short of a length that makes Watson go deep in the crease and stab it away towards midwicket
looks to whip a shortish one away, but mistimes it in front of square leg, there is no one there, Lee again rushes after it
gets away with a tossed up one that is wide outside off, Watson creams it to extra cover
this one is a lot slower outside off, but short still, he guides it to backward point
goes flat and straight close to off, Watson rocks back and cuts but cannot beat short third man
bosh! Swatto-ed away, gets a flighted ball outside off, and dismisses it in the gap between extra cover and mid off
goes flat and quick, I feel I am watching Bangladesh play, he goes back and works it on the leg side, Shakib charges after the ball
lovely shot, waited on this tossed up ball outside off, and eased it in to the gap past extra cover to the boundary
142 kph rushes on to the batsman from short of a good length, he goes for the pull but it is too quick for him, gets it in front of square and Lee charges after the ball
short one that gets big on to him, Watson adjusts to pull it in the air past midwicket
good work at backward point, it was lovely slower one from Lee, he waited on it and guided it to the left of the man there, who pounced on it and made Watson hurry
gets a fuller one and comes forward confidently to push it back to the bowler
drops this one close to the wickets and Paunikar calls him for the single, Watson hesitated, but went for it in the end
136.8 kph from Lee on a length that moves away, Watson comes forward and casually slaps it to extra cover
Gautam does it neatly, high full toss wide outside off and he picks it over point for the winning runs
fires in the yorker, nothing free about that one and no hit, they charge through for the leg bye
and another one, Tiwary backs away, Tait goes for the bouncer, he swings hard and gets the connection well enough to send it soaring it over midwicket, it;s a no-ball as well
gets one in the slot and goes over mid off this time, stands tall and lofts the full  ball one bounce to the boundary, Kolkata almost home
shot! Manoj backs away, Tait sprays this one full, and he reaches out to slice it over point for a maximum
dug in short, Gautam gets on the toes and steers to third man
pushed away with an angled blade in front of point
gets away this time, stands and punches a length ball that falls just short of mid off
goes for the big swing, it is angled in very full, and he gets it away past midwicket, there is no one on the boundary
comes forward and pushes a length ball angled in towards short midwicket
worked away in the air in front of square leg
whipped away off the pads wide of deep square leg for a couple
short and wide, turning away, keeps low and Manoj almost chops the cut on to the stumps, went for it from the crease
rocks back for the cut, but it turns sharply in and he gets it away for the single towards sweeper cover
this one does not turn, he plays for it and gets an inside edge through in front of square leg, frustration for Warne
goes down on the knee for the sweep, off the toe end of the bat in front of square
cut away to point, Gautam wants the single, but he is not getting it
tossed up on middle and leg, he pushes it away to extra cover
Gautam has had enough of the plonking and dabbing, charges out, makes room and cracks this length ball over point and to the boundary
gets a thick edge away to third man as he pushes at a fuller ball
drops this one close to the stumps on the off side and Tiwary rushes for the single
bounces from short of a good length outside off, he stands still and steers it to third man
cuts away from back of a length around leg stump, he guides it backward of point
slants this one full and wide out side off stump, he reaches out for it and misses
flat, shortish and turning in to Gautam who swivels and pulls it down to fine leg
not short enough and turning away,  Manoj cuts it away to sweeper cover
Gautam does not take the bait, pushes the generously flighted ball in front of covers for a run
turns away again, but hurries on as well, he cannot time the cut as he walks back
tossed up, Manoj pushes at it half-forward turns across him, Paunikar is excited again
turns from outside leg stump to outside off stump, leaving a confused batsman stabbing it back to the bowler
another one swinging in the air away from the batsman on the yorker length, this one is outside off though, and stabbed away towards point
fired in full on leg stump, straightens a bit in the air, somehow he manages to squeeze it away
shuffles outside the line and flicks a full delivery on the bounce to fine leg
defended off the back foot to point this time
dug in short of a length, Gautam tries to dab it to third man but is beaten
yorker from Tait, gets it right this time, Gautam just manages to dig out down the track
Gautam walks across outside the stumps, looking to go over fine leg, Tait fires it in but the ball somehow misses leg stump, it is called a wide, whose world is it? Not the bowler's
Tait has got it wrong again, this time it is a no-ball, as he bangs in a short one down leg
slung in at 150.3 kph, but very full and very wide outside off, Gautam tries to reach out, cannot get to it
played back to the bowler off the back foot

crash! this time Tiwary launches in to the pull, this short one did not get up much, was around leg stump too, he swivelled and went for the pull on one leg, not far from fine leg but it flew past him
nips back in a shade now from a length, he goes back and defends to Watson
swivels for the pull to a short one that gets big on him and hits him on the arm
good delivery full and straightening on middle stump, defended back to the bowler

cuts back in from middle stump, Gautam misses the flick, ball rolls away towards point, some hesitation as they cannot decide whether to go for it or not, decide to take on the throw from Raut, direct hit could have had him in trouble

Bisla departs finally, comes down the track to chip this fuller one over midwicket, does not time it well, Raut at midwicket goes flying in the air and comes down with the ball in his hands, super catch
goes straight on and keeps low outside off, he chops the cut back to the bowler
flat and turning in from a fuller length, worked away down the ground to long on
Bisla gets away again, beaten in flight as he looks to loft over extra cover, the outside edge goes just over and wide of point
flat and full down the leg side, swept away to Trivedi at fine leg, who messes it up, and concedes the second
tossed up full outside off stump, Gautam mistimes the drive but gets the single to mid off
Bisla is going nowhere, again he stands in the crease and looks to punch this one that moves away from a length and beats him
hops and chops a shortish one backward of point for a single
close for the cut, Gautam guides it on the bounce to point off the back foot
stands tall and punches past extra cover for a single
goes for a big slog from the crease to a length ball that moves away and beats him outside off
plonks this one in front of the crease on the leg side and they go through for the single
sets himself up for the big swing, but this flighted one dips quickly on him, he looks to cut it away as it turns away, but it stays low and beats him
Gambhir charges for the single, it was pushed away to wArne's right but he got there quickly and Gautam rushed back, what;s with him these days?
waits for this one to turn in, pushes it in front of point and off they go for the run
another flighted one on leg stump, he looks to loft it down the ground, but gets an inside edge in the air in front of square leg
tossed up outside off, Gautam rocks back for the cut, but it turns in sharply, pushes it away wide of covers
tossed up on leg stump, worked away to short fine leg
down on one knee and plays a pleasing drive off a full and wide one, but straight to cover
flicks an angled delivery off the pads through square leg
shuffles and works a length ball away in front of square off the pads
follows it up with a poor ball, short on leg stump, Gautam does not miss out, swivels and pulls it behind square leg for four
beauty from Watson, he can do everythin, slanted across Gautam, he comes forward and then it jags back in, goes between bat and pad, and somehow misses the off stump
Bisla gets away with an ungainly swipe, charges out and has a heave, but the ball falls short of mid off running to his right
stands back in the crease and punches a length ball to deep point
fuller outside off and he looks to squeeze it away, misses, Paunikar goes up again, in vain
another ripper from Tait, bangs it in short and gets it to zip away past Bisla's outside edge who pushes from the crease
Paunikar with another flying take down the leg side, Gautam got some pad on it, keeper thought there was some bat
this one is fired in from a length on the pads, gets in to an awkward position but works it away to fine leg
super short one from Tait, digs it in and gets it to move away, Bisla hops and weaves out of the line
full but again down the leg side, not called a wide, maybe it took the pad on its way to the keeper
angled across the left-hander who lets it go
short fine leg is in the circle and Watson gets the short one down leg again, tucked past that man and Gautam gets another couple of runs
full and he gets the flick away past midwicket, comes back for the second even as the throw is fired in
now tries the bouncer, but the line is down leg and Gautam comes outside the line and shoulders arms
more swing, Gautam is done in again, comes in and strikes him on the pads, going down leg stump
swings in a long way around middle stump, Gambhir gets an inside edge as he goes for it, gets it backward of square leg
beats him with another good one, this time closer to off and slower too, straightens and goes on the bounce to the keeper

appeal for caught behind, slung in very full outside off and swinging away, he went for a weak drive, and Paunikar pouched the ball and went up, but umpire Dar was unmoved, probably bat hitting the ground
shuffles and plays this one out on the leg side
keeps low outside off stump, on a length and moving away, he has a push from the crease and misses
Paunikar does well to save four byes, Tait slung this one a foot down the leg side and Paunikar went flying to his right

151 kph and gone! Tait strikes second ball, goes for a pull to a short one that was miles outside off stump, gets a steepler of a top edge that goes only vertical, comes down close to the crease and Taylor running in from square leg takes it cleanly despite the man from point charging in and then diving flat near him
shuffles across a long way and turns a length ball angled on the pads to square leg
